text:
{
  "scorecard": [
    {
      "promise": "Food delivery YoY growth trending up towards 20%",
      "made_in": "Jan 2026",
      "quote": "we expect year-on-year growth to continue slowly trending up towards 20% YoY, is what our current sense on the market is.",
      "outcome": "Overall revenue growth was 182% in Jun 2026 and 78% in Sep 2026; specific food delivery segment growth is unverifiable from consolidated table.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly results Jun 2026 / Sep 2026"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Net working capital not to exceed 18 days",
      "made_in": "Jan 2026",
      "quote": "we don't expect net working capital to be beyond those 18 days that we had shared earlier",
      "outcome": "Working capital days are not reported in the provided quarterly or annual financial tables.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly results Sep 2026"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Going-out business losses to breakeven in 4-6 quarters",
      "made_in": "Jan 2026",
      "quote": "we now expect the losses to come down sequentially from here towards breakeven in the next four to six quarters.",
      "outcome": "Tracking; 3 quarters have passed. Consolidated PAT remains positive at ₹125 Cr in Sep 2026, but segment-specific breakeven is not shown.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly results Sep 2026"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Inventory model shift benefit within 6-9 months, max 1%",
      "made_in": "Jan 2026",
      "quote": "the full benefit should accrue in the next six to nine months, and the benefit will not be more than 1%.",
      "outcome": "Blinkit inventory losses reported at 1.8% of NOV in Jul 2026, suggesting the 1% benefit cap or target is still in progress.",
      "verdict": "partly",
      "evidence_source": "Q1 FY27 call reported metrics"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Overall guidance of 60% CAGR",
      "made_in": "May 2026",
      "quote": "We've given overall guidance of 60% CAGR and that would obviously mean some reasonable store expansion",
      "outcome": "Revenue grew from ₹12,114 Cr (Mar 2024) to ₹54,364 Cr (Mar 2026), representing a CAGR well above 60%.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Annual Financials Mar 2026"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Capex per store to remain lower than INR 2.5 crore",
      "made_in": "Jul 2026",
      "quote": "If you therefore look at our capex over the last six months... it is lower than INR 2.5 crore. We expect that to continue going forward.",
      "outcome": "Specific per-store capex figures are not provided in the quarterly financial tables or subsequent reported metrics.",
      "verdict": "unverifiable",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly results Sep 2026"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Food delivery margins to remain flattish for 1-2 years",
      "made_in": "Oct 2026",
      "quote": "broadly, over the next 1 or 2 years, we expect the margins to remain flattish.",
      "outcome": "Consolidated OPM was 2.9% in Jun 2026 and 3.1% in Sep 2026. Too early to judge the 1-2 year horizon.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly results Sep 2026"
    },
    {
      "promise": "NOV growth to pick up starting December quarter YoY",
      "made_in": "Oct 2026",
      "quote": "we expect that NOV growth should pick up starting the December quarter on a YoY basis.",
      "outcome": "The December 2026 (Q3 FY27) results are not yet available in the provided data.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Quarterly results Sep 2026"
    }
  ],
  "credibility": {
    "delivered": 1,
    "partly": 1,
    "missed": 0,
    "summary": "Management demonstrates conservative revenue forecasting, significantly exceeding their 60% CAGR target. However, many operational targets (working capital, store capex) lack transparency in standard financial reporting."
  },
  "narrative_vs_numbers": [
    "Revenue growth narrative is consistently exceeded by actuals, with FY26 revenue jumping over 150% vs the 60% CAGR guide.",
    "The narrative of 'trending up' margins aligns with OPM rising from 1.2% (Mar 2025) to 3.1% (Sep 2026).",
    "Inventory model benefits (narrative <1%) conflict with reported inventory losses of 1.8% in Q1 FY27.",
    "Consolidated PAT remains positive (₹125 Cr) supporting the narrative of loss reduction across business segments."
  ]
}
